column1: # LXX-only Greek lexemes (no Strong's number) grouped by wordid (validated per-lemma
# key, see lxx/parse.py) into a citation form + all attested inflected variants, with
# per-variant occurrence count + a sample verse ref. citation_confidence=standard means
# the chosen form is on a fixed priority list of lexicon-headword-shaped forms (nom.
# singular for nouns/adjectives; for verbs, present/aorist indicative or infinitive,
# preferring active + 1st singular, even if not literally the ideal PAI1S); fallback
# means nothing on that list was attested and the most frequent form was used regardless
# of shape — worth a lexicographer's eye before treating as a final headword.
# citation_confidence=lemma: the citation form is the lemma of the GLAUx corpus, not chosen from the attested forms.
# Derived from GLAUx (A. Keersmaekers, KU Leuven; texts el.wikisource) — CC BY-SA 4.0, share-alike.
